details: For every finite concept class, $\mathrm{BTD}(\mathcal H)\geq\mathrm{RTD}(\mathcal H)$; the inequality can be strict.
proof: Theorem 32 proves the comparison. At the first layer attaining the recursive teaching dimension, the minimum ordinary teaching dimension of the remaining subclass equals that layer's value. Lemma 31 lower-bounds its Balbach dimension by this minimum, and BTD subclass monotonicity transfers the bound to $\mathcal H$.
name: Balbach Teaching Dimension / Recursive Teaching Dimension
